title: Select Employees With High Salaries
description:
Write an SQL query to report the names and salaries of all employees who have a salary strictly greater than 50,000, ordered by salary descending.

Table `Employee`: `id (INT), name (TEXT), salary (INT), department (TEXT)`
input_format: Database contains table `Employee` with seed records.

sample_tests.input:
CREATE TABLE Employee (id INT, name TEXT, salary INT, department TEXT);
INSERT INTO Employee VALUES (1, 'Alice', 60000, 'Eng'), (2, 'Bob', 45000, 'Mkt'), (3, 'Charlie', 75000, 'Eng');
sample_tests.explanation: Employees earning > 50,000 ordered by salary desc.

hidden_tests.input:
CREATE TABLE Employee (id INT, name TEXT, salary INT, department TEXT);
INSERT INTO Employee VALUES (1, 'Dan', 30000, 'HR'), (2, 'Eve', 90000, 'Sales');

hints: Include columns `name` and `salary` in the SELECT clause.
Sort results descending using `ORDER BY salary DESC`.
